install:
pip3 install --user google-api-python-client google-auth google-auth-oauthlib websockets pillow 2>/dev/null || true
chmod +x iphone-data-organizer/install.sh iphone-data-organizer/scripts/*.sh shared/bin/*.sh 2>/dev/null || true
bash shared/bin/link-repos.sh || true
git submodule update --init --recursive 2>/dev/null || true
test -f shared/README.md && echo SHARED_HUB_OK
test -d linked/beatlink && echo BEATLINK_LINKED
test -d linked/beat-drop && echo BEATDROP_LINKED || echo BEATDROP_PENDING_TOKEN
echo Shared hub + linked repos ready
